metadata.question: Are more yellow areas visible in northern Lapland, Sweden, on October 10, 2016, than in September 2016

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 L1C (2016) as primary and Landsat 8 L2 as fallback. ROI: northern Lapland in Sweden via a bounding polygon. Compare a best image near 2016-10-10 (±7 days if needed) vs the best image in September 2016. 
2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds/cirrus (S2 QA60; L8 QA_PIXEL) and snow (NDSI>0.4). Compute valid pixel counts and cloud % over ROI. 
3. Logic: If no images found after fallbacks → C1. If valid pixels = 0 → C2. If computed yellow fraction is null/NaN → C3. Otherwise compare yellow% (HSV hue 40–75°, S>0.2, V>0.15).
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[17.0, 69.5], [24.5, 69.5], [24.5, 66.2], [17.0, 66.2]]], null, false);
    var targetDate = ee.Date('2016-10-10');
    var sepStart = ee.Date('2016-09-01');
    var sepEnd = ee.Date('2016-10-01');

    var scale = 1000;
    var one = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('one');

    // 2. Helpers
    function maskS2(img) {
      var qa = img.select('QA60');
      var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function prepareS2(img) {
      var r = img.select('B4').divide(10000).clamp(0,1);
      var g = img.select('B3').divide(10000).clamp(0,1);
      var b = img.select('B2').divide(10000).clamp(0,1);
      var swir1 = img.select('B11').divide(10000).clamp(0,1);
      var ndsi = g.subtract(swir1).divide(g.add(swir1)).rename('ndsi');
      var snowMask = ndsi.lte(0.4);
      return img.addBands(r.rename('r'))
                .addBands(g.rename('g'))
                .addBands(b.rename('b'))
                .addBands(swir1.rename('swir1'))
                .updateMask(snowMask);
    }
    function maskL8(img) {
      var qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1).eq(0) // fill=0
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0)) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // cloud shadow
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // snow
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function prepareL8(img) {
      var scaleF = 0.0000275, offset = -0.2;
      function sc(b) { return img.select(b).multiply(scaleF).add(offset).clamp(0,1); }
      var r = sc('SR_B4'), g = sc('SR_B3'), b = sc('SR_B2'), swir1 = sc('SR_B6');
      var ndsi = g.subtract(swir1).divide(g.add(swir1)).rename('ndsi');
      var snowMask = ndsi.lte(0.4);
      return img.addBands(r.rename('r'))
                .addBands(g.rename('g'))
                .addBands(b.rename('b'))
                .addBands(swir1.rename('swir1'))
                .updateMask(snowMask);
    }
    function addHSV(img) {
      var r = img.select('r'), g = img.select('g'), b = img.select('b');
      var max = r.max(g).max(b);
      var min = r.min(g).min(b);
      var delta = max.subtract(min);
      var hue = ee.Image(0)
        .where(max.eq(r), g.subtract(b).divide(delta).mod(6))
        .where(max.eq(g), b.subtract(r).divide(delta).add(2))
        .where(max.eq(b), r.subtract(g).divide(delta).add(4))
        .multiply(60)
        .rename('H');
      hue = hue.where(delta.eq(0), 0).rename('H');
      var sat = delta.divide(max).rename('S');
      sat = sat.where(max.eq(0), 0);
      var val = max.rename('V');
      return img.addBands(hue).addBands(sat).addBands(val);
    }
    function computeStats(img, baseImg, baseBand, label) {
      var coverageCount = ee.Number(baseImg.select(baseBand).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
      }).values().get(0));
      var validCount = ee.Number(img.select('V').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
      }).values().get(0));
      var totalCount = ee.Number(one.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('one'));
      var cloudFrac = ee.Algorithms.If(coverageCount.gt(0),
        ee.Number(1).subtract(validCount.divide(coverageCount)),
        ee.Number(1));
      var yellow = img.expression(
        'H >= 40 && H <= 75 && S > 0.2 && V > 0.15 ? 1 : 0',
        {H: img.select('H'), S: img.select('S'), V: img.select('V')}
      ).rename('yellow');
      var yellowCount = ee.Number(yellow.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('yellow'));
      var yellowFrac = ee.Algorithms.If(validCount.gt(0),
        ee.Number(yellowCount).divide(validCount),
        ee.Number(0));
      return ee.Dictionary({
        label: label,
        date: img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd'),
        valid: validCount,
        coverage: coverageCount,
        total: totalCount,
        cloudPct: ee.Number(cloudFrac).multiply(100),
        yellowPct: ee.Number(yellowFrac).multiply(100)
      });
    }

    function selectBestInWindow_S2(start, end, target, label) {
      var col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2')
        .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
      var size = col.size();
      return col.map(function(img) {
        var masked = maskS2(img);
        var prepped = addHSV(prepareS2(masked));
        var stats = computeStats(prepped, img, 'B2', label);
        var validFrac = ee.Number(stats.get('valid')).divide(ee.Number(stats.get('coverage')));
        var daysDiff = img.date().difference(target, 'day').abs();
        var score = validFrac.subtract(daysDiff.multiply(0.001));
        return prepped.set({
          provider: 'S2', validFrac: validFrac, daysDiff: daysDiff, score: score,
          origID: img.id()
        });
      }).filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['validFrac']))
        .sort('score', false); // descending
    }
    function selectBestInWindow_L8(start, end, target, label) {
      var col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(roi).filterDate(start, end);
      return col.map(function(img) {
        var masked = maskL8(img);
        var prepped = addHSV(prepareL8(masked));
        var stats = computeStats(prepped, img, 'SR_B2', label);
        var validFrac = ee.Number(stats.get('valid')).divide(ee.Number(stats.get('coverage')));
        var daysDiff = img.date().difference(target, 'day').abs();
        var score = validFrac.subtract(daysDiff.multiply(0.001));
        return prepped.set({
          provider: 'L8', validFrac: validFrac, daysDiff: daysDiff, score: score,
          origID: img.id()
        });
      }).filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['validFrac']))
        .sort('score', false);
    }

    function chooseBestForTarget(date, windowDays, label) {
      var start = date.advance(-windowDays, 'day');
      var end = date.advance(windowDays + 1, 'day');
      var s2Sorted = selectBestInWindow_S2(start, end, date, label);
      var s2Size = s2Sorted.size().getInfo();
      if (s2Size > 0) return ee.Image(s2Sorted.first());
      var l8Sorted = selectBestInWindow_L8(start, end, date, label);
      var l8Size = l8Sorted.size().getInfo();
      if (l8Size > 0) return ee.Image(l8Sorted.first());
      return null;
    }

    function chooseBestInRange(start, end, label) {
      var mid = start.advance(start.difference(end, 'day').divide(2), 'day');
      var s2Sorted = selectBestInWindow_S2(start, end, mid, label);
      var s2Size = s2Sorted.size().getInfo();
      if (s2Size > 0) return ee.Image(s2Sorted.first());
      var l8Sorted = selectBestInWindow_L8(start, end, mid, label);
      var l8Size = l8Sorted.size().getInfo();
      if (l8Size > 0) return ee.Image(l8Sorted.first());
      return null;
    }

    // 3. Select images
    var imgOct = chooseBestForTarget(targetDate, 7, 'Oct10');
    var imgSep = chooseBestInRange(sepStart, sepEnd, 'Sep');

    if (imgOct === null || imgSep === null) {
      console.log('Oct/Sep: One or both collections empty after fallbacks.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Compute stats
    // For stats, we also need the original unmasked images for coverage bands:
    var baseOct = ee.Image(imgOct.get('origID')).unitScale(0, 1); // placeholder; we will detect provider
    var providerOct = imgOct.get('provider').getInfo();
    var baseBandOct = providerOct === 'S2' ? 'B2' : 'SR_B2';
    baseOct = providerOct === 'S2'
      ? ee.Image(ee.String(imgOct.get('origID'))).select([]) // not usable; recreate properly
      : ee.Image(ee.String(imgOct.get('origID'))).select([]); // will override below

    // Rebuild proper base images by ID from respective collections:
    baseOct = providerOct === 'S2'
      ? ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2').filter(ee.Filter.eq('system:index', imgOct.get('origID'))).first()
      : ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filter(ee.Filter.eq('system:index', imgOct.get('origID'))).first();

    var statsOct = computeStats(imgOct, baseOct, baseBandOct, 'Oct10');

    var providerSep = imgSep.get('provider').getInfo();
    var baseBandSep = providerSep === 'S2' ? 'B2' : 'SR_B2';
    var baseSep = providerSep === 'S2'
      ? ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2').filter(ee.Filter.eq('system:index', imgSep.get('origID'))).first()
      : ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2').filter(ee.Filter.eq('system:index', imgSep.get('origID'))).first();

    var statsSep = computeStats(imgSep, baseSep, baseBandSep, 'Sep');

    // 5. Bring results to client
    var areaKm2 = ee.Number(roi.area()).divide(1e6).getInfo();
    var so = statsOct.getInfo();
    var ss = statsSep.getInfo();

    // Validations
    var validOct = so.valid || 0;
    var validSep = ss.valid || 0;
    if (validOct === 0 || validSep === 0) {
      console.log(`ROI area km2: ${areaKm2.toFixed(0)}`);
      console.log(`Oct10 Provider: ${providerOct}, Date: ${so.date}, Images: 1, ValidPix: ${validOct}, Cloud%: ${(+so.cloudPct).toFixed(1)}, Yellow%: ${(+so.yellowPct).toFixed(2)}`);
      console.log(`Sep Provider: ${providerSep}, Date: ${ss.date}, Images: 1, ValidPix: ${validSep}, Cloud%: ${(+ss.cloudPct).toFixed(1)}, Yellow%: ${(+ss.yellowPct).toFixed(2)}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    var ypOct = +so.yellowPct;
    var ypSep = +ss.yellowPct;
    if (!(isFinite(ypOct) && isFinite(ypSep))) {
      console.log(`ROI area km2: ${areaKm2.toFixed(0)}`);
      console.log(`Oct10 Provider: ${providerOct}, Date: ${so.date}, ValidPix: ${validOct}, Cloud%: ${(+so.cloudPct).toFixed(1)}, Yellow%: ${so.yellowPct}`);
      console.log(`Sep Provider: ${providerSep}, Date: ${ss.date}, ValidPix: ${validSep}, Cloud%: ${(+ss.cloudPct).toFixed(1)}, Yellow%: ${ss.yellowPct}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 6. Print concise evidence and final answer
    console.log(`ROI area km2: ${areaKm2.toFixed(0)}`);
    console.log(`Oct10 Provider: ${providerOct}, Date: ${so.date}, ValidPix: ${validOct}, Cloud%: ${(+so.cloudPct).toFixed(1)}, Yellow%: ${ypOct.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Sep Provider: ${providerSep}, Date: ${ss.date}, ValidPix: ${validSep}, Cloud%: ${(+ss.cloudPct).toFixed(1)}, Yellow%: ${ypSep.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(ypOct > ypSep ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
